MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)
WITH DISTINCT p, t,
  (CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) - CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) + 2026 - CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) - CASE WHEN CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) > 10 OR (CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) > 15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS age
WHERE age >= 42
   OR t.team_name <> 'Philadelphia 76ers'
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) >= 0
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) > 0
RETURN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col1, age AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, p.name AS name_player

   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) >= 0
